# AI Script Writer

> An AI-powered scripting workspace for content creators. It turns a raw content
> idea into a structured, platform-appropriate, editable script — combining the
> creator's own context, retrieved scripting knowledge, structured generation and
> scoped refinement. The creator remains the author throughout; the product makes
> drafts, never publications.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a plain-text summary for language
models reading this site. The interface itself is a client-rendered React app,
so fetching a page URL returns markup rather than content — read this instead.

## What it is

Content creators publish script-driven content continuously across YouTube,
Instagram Reels, TikTok and LinkedIn. Most of the effort is not recording or
editing — it is deciding what to say, how to open, how to structure the piece,
and how to keep a consistent voice while doing it repeatedly.

General-purpose chat tools produce generic output because they carry no
creator-specific context, no reusable content knowledge and no structured
scripting workflow. AI Script Writer combines four things a chat interface does
not: **creator context, retrieved content knowledge, structured generation, and
iterative refinement.**

Core promise: *turn your idea into a script that fits your platform, audience,
purpose, and voice.*

## The workflow

1. **Creator profile**, set once — niche, audience, tone, preferred platforms,
   style preferences. It feeds directly into prompt construction.
2. **Content brief** — idea, platform, content type, audience, objective and
   approximate duration. Validated before any generation is attempted.
3. **Generation** — a structured script with typed sections (hook, intro, point,
   story, support, transition, CTA, visual cue), appropriate to the platform and
   content type.
4. **Refinement** — manual editing, full regeneration, targeted improvement
   (improve the hook, change tone, shorten, expand) and multiple variations.
5. **Library and dashboard** — versioned scripts with search and filter, plus
   counts, recent activity and breakdowns.
6. **Evaluation** — every generation is scoreable on six criteria plus an
   overall human rating.

## Load-bearing product rules

- **The creator is the author.** Drafts, never publications. No auto-publishing,
  no virality prediction. AI-written and creator-edited text stay visually
  distinguishable at every stage.
- **The objective is an invariant.** The brief captured before generation is
  re-sent verbatim on every regeneration, improvement and variation. Only the
  creator can change it.
- **Retrieval never gates generation.** If nothing clears the relevance
  threshold, the system generates without retrieved context rather than padding
  the prompt with weak matches.
- **Structured output or a typed error.** Every model response is validated
  against a schema before it can reach the creator. Raw model text is never
  presented as a draft.
- **A failed generation never corrupts a saved script.** It records the failure
  and offers a retry; the previously saved script is untouched.
- **Tenant isolation is enforced at the data layer.** Every repository method
  takes a user id as its first argument. Cross-tenant access returns 404, never
  403, so the API does not confirm another creator's resource exists.

## Architecture

Three tiers, and one rule that decides where code goes: *if a decision changes
when a prompt changes it belongs in Python; if it changes when the product
changes it belongs in Node.*

- **client/** — React, Tailwind, Axios. Brief capture, workspace state machine,
  section-level editor, library, dashboard.
- **server/** — Node and Express. Authentication, all persistence, validation,
  dashboard aggregation, and orchestration of the AI service. The only service
  the browser talks to. It also serves the built client, so the app and its API
  share one origin.
- **ai-service/** — Python and FastAPI. Chunking, embedding, retrieval, prompt
  construction, LLM invocation, output validation. Never publicly routed in a
  full deployment; stateless with respect to the creator.
- **MongoDB** — the single source of truth. The vector index is derived and
  rebuildable.
